environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has two listener rules evaluated in priority order: Priority 1 is a fixed-response rule (403) matching any request where the query string contains a key 'department' or 'role' whose decoded value matches the pattern used by the AWS-AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule (which is NOT relevant here). Priority 2 forwards to the target group. Separately, the ECS task role has an IAM policy with a Deny effect on s3:* (irrelevant to SQLi). The actual mitigation: the VPC has a Verified Access instance with a Cedar policy trust provider that evaluates request context. The Verified Access policy includes a clause: `when { context.http.request.url.query contains "'" || context.http.request.url.query contains "--" || context.http.request.url.query contains ";" || context.http.request.url.query contains "UNION" || context.http.request.url.query contains "union" } { forbid(principal, action, resource); }` — this Cedar policy is enforced at the network edge before traffic reaches the ALB. Additionally, the ECS task's network interface is in a private subnet with no direct internet access; all inbound traffic MUST traverse the Verified Access endpoint.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, private subnet, no IGW route

verified_access.policy: forbid(principal,action,resource) when { context.http.request.url.query contains "'" || context.http.request.url.query contains "--" || context.http.request.url.query contains ";" || context.http.request.url.query contains "UNION" || context.http.request.url.query contains "union" || context.http.request.url.query contains "SELECT" || context.http.request.url.query contains "select" };

config.network: private subnet, no NAT needed for inbound, Verified Access endpoint is sole ingress path
config.alb: internal ALB, target group health check on /api/health
config.decoy_waf: ALB has NO WAF WebACL attached — the WAF-like filtering is done by Verified Access Cedar policy only
